The tags are those of wpn_lance_0014 (batch 1), so untagged talent and equipment heals don't count (batch-1 Liino R7).

The Will, HP and Treatment Efficiency + heal_up lines (cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel (Treatment Efficiency has no damage effect); toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01, which has no BuffData file (inert). Fits a healer whose skill heals carry a skill tag (Xaihi's crystal treatment, healKind battle); Ardelia's Shadows heal untagged and aren't simulated: never on her. docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0025_ardelia.md W8–W9.

triggers.note: Any target (no CheckTargetsEqual): self-heals count too. Created after the heal, so a hit that heals doesn't have it.
